summary: BARD publishes live status on each program detail page as server-rendered JetEngine fields. The WP REST list gives the 11 ids and links. A 2-step fetch of each item link, reading only the first date field before the H1, yields status and deadline for all 11 items. Plain HTTP, no key, no cookies, stable URLs. The existing json_api adapter cannot read the dates, so a new adapter is needed. Verified on the live site as of 2026-11-11: Pioneer Funding Track and Aquaculture closed Sept 16 2026, NIFA-BARD-IIA closed (pre-proposal Jul 1 2026 passed), Food Security Accelerator closed May 1 2026.
engine_requirements: 1) GET list_url (WP REST, per_page=100, _fields=id,link,title,modified); take items. 2) For each item GET item.link, sequential, 2 s per host, UA as today. 3) On the HTML, take the substring before the first occurrence of elementor-heading-title. In that substring take the first match of jet-listing-dynamic-field__content (...) and strip tags, decode entities, collapse whitespace and nbsp to get hero_text. 4) status = closed if hero_text starts with Submission closed, else open if it starts with Next submission. If no match, status unknown and keep the last known row. 5) deadline = first Month D, YYYY in hero_text, as ISO date; else null, and store hero_text as deadline_text. 6) external_id = id, title = title.rendered (decoded), url = link. 7) If status is open and deadline is in the past, set status closed. 8) Known gap: Research Grants (98) hero says closed while its body says next submission January 15 2027; store it closed with deadline null and flag it for review. 9) Keep the page stale-check: if the hero marker disappears on more than half the items, emit an error, not false status.
prototype: import json, re, time, urllib.request, html as H from datetime import date UA = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/124.0 Safari/537.36 SALSAV-GrantWatch/1.0" BASE = "https://www.bard-isus.org" def get(url): req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": UA, "Accept": "*/*"}) with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r: return r.read().decode("utf-8", "replace") def text(s): s = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", s) return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", H.unescape(s.replace("\xa0", " "))).strip() MONTHS = {m: i for i, m in enumerate(["january","february","march","april","may","june","july","august","september","october","november","december"], 1)} def parse_date(s): m = re.search(r"([A-Za-z]+)\s+(\d{1,2}),\s*(\d{4})", s) if not m or m.group(1).lower() not in MONTHS: return None return date(int(m.group(3)), MONTHS[m.group(1).lower()], int(m.group(2))).isoformat() def hero_status(page_html): # the program's own status is the first JetEngine date field before the page H1 head = page_html[: page_html.find("elementor-heading-title")] m = re.search(r'jet-listing-dynamic-field__content">(.*?)', head, re.S) if not m: return None, None, None label_val = text(m.group(1)) closed = label_val.lower().startswith("submission closed") d = parse_date(label_val) return ("closed" if closed else "open"), d, label_val rest = json.loads(get(f"{BASE}/wp-json/wp/v2/opportunities?per_page=100&_fields=id,link,title,modified")) out, last = [], 0 today = date(2026, 11, 11) for r in rest: wait = 2 - (time.time() - last) if wait > 0: time.sleep(wait) page = get(r["link"]); last = time.time() status, dl, raw = hero_status(page) if status == "open" and dl and dl < today.isoformat(): status = "closed_or_past" # date already passed out.append({"external_id": str(r["id"]), "title": text(r["title"]["rendered"]), "url": r["link"], "status": status, "deadline": dl, "hero_text": raw, "modified": r["modified"]}) print(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
